name: Split PDF
tagline: Pull pages out into separate files, one per page or by range. Nothing is uploaded.
description: Split a PDF into separate files for free in your browser: every page on its own, or custom ranges like 1-3, 5, 8-. Nothing is uploaded.

specs.Ranges: Single pages, ranges and open ranges, e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. The PDF is read and split inside this browser tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

faq.q: How do I write page ranges?
faq.a: Separate ranges with commas. 2 is a single page, 4-7 is pages 4 to 7, 8- runs to the end and -3 starts at page 1. Each range becomes its own file.

faq.q: Can I pull out a few pages into one file?
faq.a: Yes. Choose custom ranges and enter one range, for example 3-6.
